scholarships.title: Scholarship Program for Studying at Universities in Kazakhstan (Bolashak / Center for International Programs)
scholarships.official_source: JSC "Center for International Programs" (Bolashak), Republic of Kazakhstan

existing.description: The Scholarship Program for Studying at Universities in Kazakhstan awards government-funded places to international applicants at Kazakh universities. The operator is JSC "Center for International Programs", the same state body that administers the Bolashak international scholarship established by Decree of the President of Kazakhstan in 1993. The 2026 intake offered 490 Bachelor's places, 50 Master's places and 10 PhD places, applied for online through the Study in Kazakhstan portal between 30 March and 31 May 2026. The list of participating universities and available fields is published on the Study in portal during the application window, and applications may be submitted in Kazakh, Russian or English.
eligibility: Open to international applicants applying to study at universities in Kazakhstan participating in the scholarship programme
Applicant must apply within the published window through the Study in Kazakhstan portal
Application for the full period of study must be completed in Kazakh, Russian or English
requirements: Submit the application online at https://studyin.kz/admission within the published window
Choose a participating university and field of study from the list published on the Study in portal during the application window
Complete the application for the full period of study in Kazakh, Russian or English
application_method: Consult the list of participating universities and available fields on the Study in portal during the application window
Register and apply online at https://studyin.kz/admission between 30 March and 31 May 2026
Submit the application in Kazakh, Russian or English for the full period of study
existing.selection_notes: Place allocation is capped by discipline: 490 Bachelor's, 50 Master's and 10 PhD places for the 2026 intake, with the participating universities and fields of study published on the Study in portal during the application window.
existing.duration: Not published on the page read; the application covers the full period of study.
existing.application_period: Online applications open 30 March and close 31 May 2026 at 23:59 Astana time, via https://studyin.kz/admission
